'''challenger Weird Deal''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[challenger]]
* '''Published:''' 9 November 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Deal challenger DS 2003 WeirdDea.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

In rough format, please don’t rate poorly due to that fact. It’s a Deal trying out the new Special Delivery (V). Not cleaned up yet.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

If you can’t figure it out basically, please don’t review, no offense or anything, though. Essentially, use ED(V) to get out Carbon Chamber Console ASAP and then you can start using SD(V) to get out MP for Executor, TMNALTC for free deployment of it, Ast. Shortage (V) cuz it’s great, Krayt Bones (V) to eat people, AAA for damage, BFHI for extra deploy. And then you should know how Deal works.
